name: omatic-project-bot
description: Project Bot and specialist workflows for o-MATIC Foundry; requires an authorized o-MATIC Server connection.

interface.longDescription: Project Bot coordinates an o-MATIC factory request end to end and routes material work to specialist roles for documents, data retrieval, software, marketing, and visual design. Requires a separate authenticated o-MATIC Server connection. Host-specific orchestration and permissions must be configured and verified.
capabilities: Coordinate a factory request from plan through verification
Use connected o-MATIC Server tools when authenticated and authorized
Route work to specialist role skills where supported
interface.prompt: Start the o-MATIC factory and report the live checks and available specialists.
